manifest.binary: The sparkles CLI built with mbx build --release -p sparkles-server on atlas at commit 81851812, stripped and copied to the benchmark host

reference.robot: ROBOT 1.9.11's materialize has only laptop figures, 14.4 s on GO and 37.7 s on ChEBI lite with an 8 GiB heap, from lane 604. Its forge stage is in the batch roadmap item 636 left to the maintainer.

method: forge-sparkles.sh.txt took ~/lanes/.bench.lock once and ran three interleaved rounds. Each round timed, from the release's RDF/XML file to a functional-style file, sparkles ontology reason, materialize with one property (part of, BFO:0000050, on GO and has role, RO:0000087, on ChEBI lite) and materialize with every object property on both, and on GO also materialize with regulates (RO:0002211) and the chain reason --input FILE materialize --term BFO:0000050 reduce --output FILE, each through timed.py.txt, which records the wall time, the peak resident set and the exit status in runs.jsonl. compare.txt is scripts/elk-compare/ofn-axioms.py --all between lane 604's ROBOT outputs and the same build's outputs on atlas.
scale: GO 2026-07-26 and ChEBI lite 256, RDF/XML releases
